raw_output:
Giver: Hi there, can I give you some directions?
Follower: Sure, go ahead.
Giver: Okay, start at the top left. Find the little cross, that's where you begin.
Follower: Got it.
Giver: From there, head down a bit, then turn right towards the haystack. Pass it on your left side.
Follower: Okay, heading toward the haystack.
Giver: Don't go too close to it, keep it on the left. Now, turn right. You'll pass the carpenter on your right side.
Follower: Found the carpenter. Okay, passing them on the right.
Giver: Good. Keep going right now. You'll see the seven beeches coming up. Pass them on the left.
Follower: Wait, I don't see the seven beeches anywhere.
Giver: Oh? Where are they? They're just past the carpenter, slightly to the left.
Follower: Ah, okay, there they are. Passing them on the left.
Giver: Good. Now turn right. You'll see a chapel. Pass it on the right.
Follower: Okay, turning right... wait, there's no chapel here.
Giver: What? There must be one. Let me check. Ah, maybe you're near the wrong spot. Keep going straight a bit more.
Follower: Okay, going straight... wait, I see a cottage instead. Is that the chapel?
Giver: No, the cottage isn't on my map. Just keep going straight for a bit more.
Follower: Okay, still going straight... okay, there it is. Passing the chapel on the right.
Giver: Perfect. Now you'll see the reclaimed fields on your right. Don't miss them.
Follower: Found the fields. Okay, keeping them on the right.
Giver: Good. Now turn left. You'll come across a bay with a crane. Pass that on the left side.
Follower: Okay, turning left... wait, I see a crashed spaceship there instead of a crane.
Giver: Oh? That's weird. My map doesn't show a spaceship. Keep going left past that spot, there's a bay with a crane further down.
Follower: Okay, I see the crane bay now. Passing it on the left.
Giver: Good. Now turn right. You'll see a vast meadow. Pass it on the right.
Follower: Okay, turning right... wait, the vast meadow is on the left of me.
Giver: What? Did you turn the wrong way?
Follower: No, I'm on the right side of the path, but the meadow is definitely to my left now.
Giver: Oh, sorry, I meant the meadow should be on your right. Maybe you're on the wrong side of the road.
Follower: Okay, let me retrace. I'll go back to the meadow and pass it on the right.
Giver: Okay, that should be better. Now keep going. You'll see the attractive cliffs on the left.
Follower: Found the cliffs. Okay, passing them on the left.
Giver: Good. Now turn right. You'll see some moored boats. Pass them on the right.
Follower: Okay, turning right... wait, I see a chestnut tree on the left now.
Giver: Oh no, what's happening? The chestnut tree should be on the right at the end. Are you sure you're on the right track?
Follower: I'm confused. I see a chestnut tree on the left, but you said the cliffs were on the left before that. Am I going in the wrong direction?
Giver: No, wait. Let me explain. From the cliffs, turn right. You should see the boats on the right. Then the chestnut tree will be on the right at the very end.
Follower: Okay, turning right from the cliffs... wait, I see a crashed spaceship again. Is that the start?
Giver: No, the start is way up at the top left. The spaceship isn't on my map. Just ignore it and keep going to the right.
Follower: Okay, ignoring the spaceship. Turning right... okay, I see the boats now. Passing them on the right.
Giver: Good. Now keep going straight. You'll see the chestnut tree on the right. That's where you finish.
Follower: Okay, seeing the chestnut tree... wait, it's on the left of me.
Giver: What? I said it's on the right. Are you facing the wrong way?
Follower: No, I'm facing the same way. It's just... it's on the left here.
Giver: Oh, maybe I gave the wrong instructions. Just draw a line from the boats to the chestnut tree directly.
Follower: Okay, drawing a line... wait, where exactly do I draw the line?
Giver: From the boats, head straight left until you hit the chestnut tree.
Follower: Okay, drawing a line... wait, that goes off the map!
Giver: Oh no, sorry. That's wrong. The chestnut tree is on the right side of the map. Head right from the boats.
Follower: Okay, heading right... there it is! Finished!
Giver: Great job!
Follower: Thanks, you were a bit confusing but I got it!
Giver: No problem. Good luck!
Follower: Bye!
Giver: Bye!
